name: Please Be Quiet Johor 2024

venue.name: Play Day
venue.address: 35-2, Jln Molek 3/20, Taman Molek, 81100 Johor Bahru, Johor

information:
# Note: This competition does not feature the 3x3x3 Cube event. 

Welcome to Please Be Quiet Johor 2024! This will be a small competition featuring only blindfolded events. For those who are interested in joining **Malaysia FMC Championship 2024** can register through [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaFMCChampionship2024). The event will take place at the same venue immediately after the end of this competition.

[![Malaysia Cube Association(MYCSA)](https://imgur.com/ZUv6wZJ.jpg)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/Competition/Info/PleaseBeQuietJohor2024)
